title: Exclusive PREMIUM Sri Lanka | Romantic Escape
highlights: Enjoy the beauty of Sri Lanka, with Bentota’s sandy beaches for relaxation and Colombo’s lively streets for shopping and culture.
Visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery to see baby sea turtles and learn about efforts to protect these endangered creatures.
Relax on Bentota Beach, renowned for being a perfect spot for sunbathing, swimming, and water sports.
Marvel at the Colombo Lotus Tower, South Asia’s tallest structure, which stands at 350 meters and offers an unparalleled views of the city.
Explore the Vibrant Pettah Floating Market, where you can shop for local goods from colorful boats and experience the lively atmosphere of Colombo’s trade hub.
overview:
About the tour:
Be pampered by our world-renowned Golden Keys Concierge and butlers, and enjoy sumptuous in-room dining experiences. Come, experience the magic of this palm-lined haven on the harbour. Enjoy every minute of it. Be it the ocean, the forest or even the city, you’ll be able to soak it all in, what makes the soul-satisfying everything make it a paradise that bedazzles everyone!
Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Bentota | Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery Visit
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon your arrival at the airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel in Bentota. Check in and take some time to relax. Later, board the transfer to the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, a renowned conservation project dedicated to protecting endangered sea turtles. Here, you'll have the unique opportunity to learn about the various species of turtles that nest along Sri Lanka's coastlines. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, you’ll be driven for Bentota city tour, starting with a visit to Bentota Beach, where you can engage in thrilling water sports like jet skiing, banana rides, and tube rides. Next, enjoy a scenic boat ride along the Madu River, enjoying the views of lush mangroves. Continue your exploration with a visit to Cinnamon Island, where you can discover the aromatic cinnamon plantations and learn about the spice trade. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, check out and get transferred to Colombo. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can explore Colombo on your own, visiting sites like the Old City Hall, the Dutch Period Museum and the Traditional Puppet Art Museum to catch a glimpse of Colombo's rich history. You can also head to Attidiya Bird Sanctuary and Dehiwala Zoo to have an engaging experience with a variety of animals and birds. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, you’ll be driven for a Colombo city tour. Your first stop is the Gangaramaya Temple, a significant cultural and spiritual landmark. Next, marvel at the Colombo Lotus Tower, the tallest structure in South Asia. You can also ascend to the observation deck for panoramic views of the city. Later, wander through the bustling Pettah Floating Market before visiting Galle Face Green, a popular oceanside promenade to enjoy stunning sunset views. Later, you will be driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out and board the transfer to Colombo Airport for your flight back home.
